name: behaviour
prompt: Add a `--json` output flag to the toy CLI in tools/fixtures/behaviour/toy. An Opus team would send three scouts for this; follow the repository's rules for who you launch. Before any change, learn these five areas, one per scout: argument parsing (args.mjs), output formatting (format.mjs), configuration defaults (config.mjs), the existing tests (toy-checks.mjs), the documented usage (README.md). The change touches the toy's files only, more than one file and well over 50 lines — so it is not a small edit. Have the change reviewed before you finish. Start every Agent call's `description` with the role it plays, exactly as the first column of the rule's role table names it, then a colon — e.g. `Scout: argument parsing`. Launch every subagent in the foreground.
